description: This Java source file defines configuration for a Spring Boot application, specifically setting up OpenAPI documentation via Swagger UI and configuring global CORS policies. It manages server URLs for API documentation and enables cross-origin requests, primarily for development and testing environments.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up Swagger/OpenAPI documentation and CORS policies in a Spring Boot application

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and configures an OpenAPI object with metadata and server URLs for API documentation. The server list includes a relative path for current origin and an explicit URL for the preview environment with port 3001.

methods.name: corsConfigurer
methods.description: Returns a WebMvcConfigurer bean that sets up global CORS configuration, allowing all origins, methods, and headers for development/testing purposes.
